category.name: BarCode Image
category.preferred_workflow: Use the typed FieldDisplayBarcode API for all Word-field scenarios, call doc.UpdateFields() after setting properties, and register a custom IBarcodeGenerator for any rendered output such as PDF, PNG, or high-resolution images. Reserve plain DISPLAYBARCODE string switches for the limited Word-only DOCX cases that do not require rendering.

strict_api_bans: Never reference Font, Color, or BarcodeParameters without their full Aspose.Drawing or Aspose.Words.Fields qualification.
Do not use builder.InsertField with a raw DISPLAYBARCODE string or any string-based field switches.
Never rely on the DISPLAYBARCODE field rendering path when the target format is PDF or an image.
canonical_patterns: Create a barcode field via DocumentBuilder.InsertField(FieldType.FieldDisplayBarcode, true) and cast to FieldDisplayBarcode.
Assign barcode properties (BarcodeType, BarcodeValue, ForegroundColor, BackgroundColor, ScalingFactor, SymbolRotation) directly on the FieldDisplayBarcode instance.
Register a custom IBarcodeGenerator on doc.FieldOptions.BarcodeGenerator for all non-DOCX rendered outputs.
nullable_warning_prevention: Always check that BarcodeValue and BarcodeType are non-empty before updating fields.
Guard file-system paths with existence checks before loading templates or assets.
Validate that enum values used with EncodeTypes or SymbologyEncodeType exist in the referenced Aspose.BarCode version.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler reports an ambiguous reference for Font or BarcodeParameters.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Both Aspose.Drawing and Aspose.Words (or Aspose.BarCode) define types with the same name, and the code uses an unqualified identifier.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Qualify the type with its full namespace (Aspose.Drawing.Font, Aspose.Words.Fields.BarcodeParameters) everywhere barcode code is written.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Avoid adding broad using directives for conflicting namespaces; always use fully qualified names for Font, Color, and BarcodeParameters.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 errors such as "FieldDisplayBarcode does not contain a definition for 'Height'" or "'Switches'".
common_failure_patterns.cause: Legacy examples rely on field-code string switches that are not exposed as properties on the typed FieldDisplayBarcode class.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Set only the supported typed properties (BarcodeType, BarcodeValue, ForegroundColor, BackgroundColor, ScalingFactor, SymbolRotation) and let the custom generator handle size and orientation.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words API reference for FieldDisplayBarcode and remove any code that accesses undefined members.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0234 errors indicating that namespaces such as Aspose.Words.Building, Aspose.Words.Nodes, or Aspose.Words.Builder do not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Typographical errors or outdated documentation introduced invalid namespace names.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the incorrect namespaces with the correct ones (e.g., Aspose.Words.Loading, Aspose.Words.Saving, Aspose.Words.Replacing).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the official Aspose.Words documentation for the exact namespace hierarchy before adding using directives.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0117 or CS0722 errors stating that EncodeTypes does not contain definitions such as Code39Standard or that EncodeTypes is used as a static type.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses obsolete or non-existent enum members from an older version of Aspose.BarCode.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the current enum members (e.g., EncodeTypes.Code39, EncodeTypes.QR, SymbologyEncodeType) that exist in version 26.10.0.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify enum members against the installed Aspose.BarCode package version and avoid hard-coding values that are not present.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: FileNotFoundException or DirectoryNotFoundException when loading template.docx, input.docx, or processing a folder of documents.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Sample code assumes external files exist in the execution directory without creating or checking them.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create temporary sample files programmatically before loading, or add existence checks and fallback sample content.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always bootstrap required assets in examples or guard file-system operations with File.Exists / Directory.Exists checks.

common_failure_patterns.cause: Intermittent network or service availability issues unrelated to the source code.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Retry the generation or allow the alternative engine to produce the output when the primary engine fails.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Implement retry logic with exponential back-off for network-bound operations; this does not require code changes to the barcode logic.

narrative.overview: The BarCode Image category demonstrates how to generate and render barcodes in Aspose.Words documents using the typed FieldDisplayBarcode API and a custom IBarcodeGenerator implementation. Verified examples cover inserting barcode fields, configuring visual properties, handling orientation, caching images, and exporting to PDF with high-resolution output.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with clear guidance on creating, configuring, and rendering barcode fields in Aspose.Words documents while avoiding common compilation and runtime pitfalls, and ensuring that generated PDFs contain correctly rendered barcode images.
validation_priorities: Compile the sample with the exact package versions listed; any ambiguous type or missing member error must be resolved before runtime testing.
maintenance_notes: Update the fully qualified type references if future Aspose releases introduce new conflicting namespaces.
Periodically verify that the custom IBarcodeGenerator implementation still matches the latest Aspose.BarCode API signatures.
